item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 8 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 8 #VISPRSD
Issued at 07:55 AM 02 September 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Aklan(Buruanga, Malay), #Antique(Pandan), #Iloilo(Oton, Zarraga and BarotacNuevo) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Antique(Libertad), #Aklan(Nabas, Ibajay), #Iloilo(Guimbal, Tigbauan and Dumangas) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
